input: I am absolutely furious about the state of my account. I just bought a high-end mountain bike and camping gear from you, and now I’m locked out because of your ridiculous email verification policy. I signed up, but I didn’t realize I had to verify my email within 24 hours of registration to avoid suspension. I was busy unpacking my new gear and completely missed that deadline. Now, my account is suspended, and I can’t access my order details or track my shipment. This is unacceptable for a first-time buyer. I paid full price for premium equipment, and now I’m being treated like a criminal because I didn’t check my inbox in time. I need this resolved immediately. I don’t care if I have to provide ID or proof of purchase; I want my account reinstated and my order processed. Do not send me generic automated responses. I expect a human to call me back within the hour to fix this mess. If you don’t, I’m taking my business elsewhere and leaving a very public review about your terrible customer service.
